aviation_incidents.headline: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260教練機相撞致4死 國防部展開調查並停飛機隊
aviation_incidents.summary: 菲律賓國防部（DND）已針對菲律賓空軍（PAF）兩架SF-260教練機相撞墜毀事故展開調查。該起事故於2026年10月23日發生在八打雁省利帕市的費爾南多空軍基地（Fernando Air Base），導致機上4名飛行員全部殉職。國防部發布聲明表示，調查將秉持徹底與客觀原則，以釐清事實真相、確定事故原因，並找出需要採取糾正措施的漏洞，防止類似悲劇再次發生。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Philippines Probes SF-260 Trainer Aircraft Crash That Killed Four Pilots
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Department of National Defense (DND) of the Philippines has launched an investigation into a fatal midair collision involving two Philippine Air Force (PAF) SF-260 trainer aircraft. The accident occurred on October 23, 2026, at Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas, resulting in the deaths of all four pilots on board. In an official statement, the defense ministry affirmed its commitment to conducting a thorough and objective investigation to establish the facts, determine the underlying causes, and identify systemic gaps to prevent future occurrences.

aviation_incidents.headline: UPS以波音767貨機取代27架MD-11機隊
aviation_incidents.summary: UPS航空於今年1月宣布，27架麥道MD-11廣體貨機將全數退役，改由較新的波音767-300F接替。報導指出，雖然飛安是首要考量，但最終決定仍基於商業因素：2025年11月UPS2976號班機在路易維爾起飛後墜毀，造成15人罹難，調查發現左翼發動機掛架出現關鍵故障，後續檢測將使機隊長時間停擺，而UPS最終以近1.4億美元損失將整批MD-11除帳，聯邦快遞則選擇讓同型機恢復服務。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: UPS to replace its 27 MD-11s with Boeing 767 freighters
aviation_incidents.summary_en: In January, UPS Airlines announced that it would retire its entire fleet of 27 McDonnell Douglas MD-11 widebody cargo jets to be replaced by the newer Boeing 767-300F. Safety of flight was a primary concern, but the final decision was based on business: the investigation of UPS flight 2976 revealed a critical failure of the left-wing engine pylon that would have required extensive non-destructive testing of the remaining jets, and UPS wrote off the entire MD-11 fleet at a loss of nearly $140 million. FedEx, by contrast, returned its examples to service.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國內線午後陸續恢復 民航局協調加班與放大機型
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國內線航班午後陸續恢復後，交通部民用航空局協調航空公司加開班機或放大機型，共計25架次，其中澎湖航線17架次、金門航線8架次，提供2,251個座位。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Domestic Flights Resume as CAA Taiwan Coordinates 25 Capacity Increases
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Domestic flights in Taiwan gradually resumed during the afternoon, the Civil Aeronautics Administration said. It coordinated with airlines to add flights or use larger aircraft for a total of 25 flight operations: 17 on Penghu routes and eight on Kinmen routes, providing 2,251 seats.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部民用航空局最新公佈的違規事件裁罰資訊指出，臺灣虎航一架A320-271N飛機的二號發動機燃燒室延遲缺點檢查管制逾期，依民航法遭裁罰新臺幣20萬元，並被要求立即改善。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Tigerair fined NT$200,000 over overdue engine inspection
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: The Civil Aviation Administration’s latest published violation information says Taiwan Tigerair was fined NT$200,000 under the Civil Aviation Act after an inspection control deadline for the No. 2 engine’s combustion-chamber deferred defect passed. The authority also required immediate improvement.

international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士與英國航太系統（BAE Systems）將就空中巴士在全球作戰空中計畫（GCAP）中扮演角色的可能機會展開會談。會談預計在未來數週舉行，討論多種合作選項，其中包括無人自主協同作戰飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus set to discuss GCAP fighter opportunities with BAE Systems, FT reports
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus and BAE Systems are set for talks over possible opportunities for the European planemaker to play a role in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), according to the Financial Times. The talks are expected to take place in the coming weeks and will cover a range of cooperation options, including uncrewed autonomous collaborative aircraft.

international_aviation.headline: AMAC Aerospace集團維修、客艙完成與改裝業務需求強勁
international_aviation.summary: AMAC Aerospace集團表示公司業務全速運轉，已取得新的認證、簽署合約，維修、客艙完成與改裝服務的需求持續增加。公司指出，巴塞爾機庫的龐巴迪維修專案較2025年增加25%，今年即將對一架龐巴迪Global Express執行第三次8C檢查，是首度在單一年度內完成三次這類龐巴迪飛機大修檢查。公司也簽下新合約，將為一架預定2027年初交付的龐巴迪挑戰者系列飛機進行醫療後送改裝，並可能在2028年接續第二個專案。
international_aviation.headline_en: AMAC Aerospace reports strong demand across maintenance, completions and modifications
international_aviation.summary_en: Operations are running at full speed at AMAC Aerospace Group of Companies, with new approvals secured, contracts signed and increasing demand across maintenance, completion and modification services. The company says Bombardier maintenance projects at its Basel hangars are up 25% compared with 2025, and it is about to perform its third 8C check on a Bombardier Global Express this year, the first time it has completed three such major inspections on Bombardier aircraft within a single year. It has also signed a new contract for a medevac installation on a Bombardier Challenger aircraft scheduled to arrive at the beginning of 2027, with a possible second project to follow in 2028.
